description: This file defines an API service module for the Planet Tracker frontend. It provides functions for interacting with backend endpoints, including fetching Near-Earth Objects (NEOs), planetary positions, and health status. It uses fetch API for HTTP requests and handles error scenarios with JSON parsing.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified endpoint with query parameters and parses the JSON response, with error handling.

methods.name: fetchNeos({ date, page, per_page } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of Near-Earth Objects (NEOs) for a given date with pagination support.

methods.name: fetchPlanets({ date } = {})
methods.description: Fetches planetary positions for a specified date.

methods.name: fetchHealth()
methods.description: Performs a health check on the backend service.

ctags.name: fetchNeos
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchNeos({ date, page, per_page } = {}) {$/
